svg.title: Raspberry Pi 5 ports, top view
svg.desc: Top view of the Raspberry Pi 5 with the GPIO header at the top. Numbers match the assembly steps: 1, fit the Active Cooler over the middle of the board first; 2, optionally connect an M.2 HAT to the PCIe ribbon connector on the left edge; 3, plug Ethernet into the jack at the bottom-right corner; 4, connect the TV to HDMI0, the micro-HDMI port next to the USB-C power port; 5, the USB-C power port at the bottom-left, plugged in last. HDMI1 stays empty. The microSD slot is under the left edge, and the four USB ports are on the right edge.
